title: CondoGuard Liability and Medical Payments Limits
content:
Personal liability on the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy is written at one of two limits per tier. Moving from the lower of the two to the higher is one step along the tier's liability options, and each tier sets an annual premium per step. Medical payments to others is a fixed per-person limit by tier.

| Tier | Personal liability limits offered (USD) | Annual premium per liability step (USD) | Medical payments to others, per person (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential | 100000 or 300000 | 12.00 | 1000 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Enhanced | 300000 or 500000 | 12.00 | 2500 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Essential | 300000 or 500000 | 14.00 | 2500 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Enhanced | 300000 or 500000 | 14.00 | 5000 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier | 500000 or 1000000 | 18.00 | 5000 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature | 500000 or 1000000 | 18.00 | 10000 |

## Lower and higher limit of each tier

| Tier | Lower limit (USD) | Higher limit (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential | 100000 | 300000 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Enhanced | 300000 | 500000 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Essential | 300000 | 500000 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Enhanced | 300000 | 500000 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier | 500000 | 1000000 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature | 500000 | 1000000 |

## Illustration (hypothetical policy)

A CondoGuard HO-6 Special Essential policy carrying personal liability of 300000 USD is at the lower of its tier's two limits; one step along the tier's options takes it to 500000 USD, the higher limit, and the tier's annual premium per step is 14.00 USD. A policy of the same tier already carrying 500000 USD is at the higher limit. A limit of 300000 USD is the higher limit on CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential but the lower limit on CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Enhanced.
